remarks: Welcome to 295 Haviland Road, a beautifully updated 5-bedroom, 3.5-bath home in sought-after North Stamford offering modern comfort, luxurious finishes and timeless appeal. Step inside this stunning home and fall in love with the warmth and elegance of beautiful hardwood and bamboo floors flowing throughout. The renovated kitchen features custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, and stainless-steel appliances, perfect for cooking and entertaining. Stylishly updated baths showcase quality finishes and contemporary design, creating a spa-like feel throughout. Spacious, sun-filled living areas flow seamlessly for everyday living and gatherings. Step outside and enjoy your own private outdoor retreat featuring a beautifully designed paver patio - perfect for relaxing or entertaining. This inviting space is ideal for summer barbecues, outdoor dining, or simply unwinding with your morning coffee. Nestled on a private, wooded lot, this home offers peace and tranquility while remaining close to schools, shopping, dining, and major commuter routes. Move right in and enjoy the perfect blend of classic charm, modern updates, and the natural beauty that define North Stamford living.
